message.content:
A number has three digits in base \(5\) if

\[
5^2 \le n < 5^3
\]

so

\[
25 \le n < 125.
\]

A number has two digits in base \(8\) if

\[
8^1 \le n < 8^2
\]

so

\[
8 \le n < 64.
\]

The integers satisfying both conditions are

\[
25 \le n \le 63.
\]

There are

\[
63-25+1=39
\]

such integers. Their average is the average of the first and last terms:

\[
\frac{25+63}{2}=\frac{88}{2}=44.
\]

The answer is 44.
